gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Noto Sans Osmanya has lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Grandstander, the heading, draws its lines in one plain width, bold and expressive, so the two fit together as loud, flat headline shapes over a body with a roomier, bulkier stance.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-: Expressive and bold, Grandstander draws every stroke without any swelling, while Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sits beneath it with a high x-height and gapped rounds. Paragraphs in that sans feel modern and unfussy.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-palmyre: Grandstander is bold and signage-plain in every line weight. Under it, Noto Sans Palmyrene lets its curves stop short and keeps its ascenders compressed, so a long run of text feels clean, modern and tightly kept.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin: Open-ended curves with room to breathe give the body a clean, modern feel, and its capitals rise only a short step above the lowercase. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau is the one to nudge up in size, leaving bold, flat-stroked Grandstander alone.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-saurash: Grandstander's bold letters never thicken or thin anywhere. That makes it a natural for big, short headings, while Noto Sans Saurashtra follows with capitals barely taller than their neighbors and counters open to the outside.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-sc: Rounded cord-cut strokes, bold and bouncy. Noto Sans SC follows in the body with chalky curves that stop well before closing and ascenders that barely clear the x-height, so a long passage reads modern and neutral.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Open c forms that never close into rings, plus bulky lowercase proportions, give the body a clean, businesslike look. Noto Sans Sharada handles the quiet text, while Grandstander, with its n arches as thick as the stems, handles the shouting.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and contemporary, the body has a large central band in each line and an s whose ends hang far from the spine. And Grandstander, bold and free of any brush-style swell, gives it a plain-spoken headline above.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Dark, dense and sturdy, with a thick stripe of lowercase through every line and curve endings that stay well apart, so the body feels very present. Noto Sans Sinhala may want its size nudged, while Grandstander stays as is.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads with a sizable x-height and curved letters whose mouths stay wide open, a good fit for screens. And Grandstander, bold with its pencil-line consistency, sets the tone above while the text quietly does its work.
